MongoDB performance guidance describes the default index-creation configuration as dynamic.
statements.note: Index-performance page says field mapping defaults to dynamic when creating an index.

edits.rationale: The field-mappings page says omitting mappings.dynamic in a search index definition defaults to false. The index-performance page separately says that when you create a Search index, field mapping defaults to dynamic. The two statements refer to different defaults (the definition's omitted field versus the default creation experience), so the contrast in the claim is supported by the two pages together.
